mapper.select: SELECT B.BLDG_ID, B.RENTAL_PTY_ID, B.BLDG_NM, B.BLDG_ZIP_NO, B.BLDG_ADDR, B.BLDG_DTL_ADDR, B.BLDG_TYPE_CODE, B.BLDG_FLR_CNT, B.BLDG_UNIT_CNT, B.BLDG_CMPLTN_DT, B.BLDG_GROSS_AREA, B.BLDG_IMG_PATH, B.BLDG_TYPE_GROUP_CD, B.DEL_YN, T.RENTAL_PTY_ID T_RENTAL_PTY_ID FROM BUILDING B LEFT JOIN TENANCY T ON B.RENTAL_PTY_ID = T.RENTAL_PTY_ID WHERE B.RENTAL_PTY_ID = #{rentalPtyId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY B.BLDG_ID ASC
